package_observables.z3: QF_NRA installed SAT and forced UNSAT second-carrier searches plus load-bearing controls

positive_tests.installed_incomplete: SAT under z3 and cvc5; C2 reproduces Z/X and differs in the unmeasured carrier coordinate
